text:
NimbleGrid is a Series B startup building a real-time analytics platform that helps retail teams optimize pricing and inventory across thousands of SKUs. We move fast, ship often, and rely on a small team of engineers to design scalable services that process high-volume event streams with low latency.

What you'll do
- Own and build backend services in Go that power core data ingestion, transformation, and API layers.
- Design and implement microservices with clear APIs, robust error handling, and automated tests.
- Collaborate with product and data teams to define service contracts and SLAs, then deliver reliable, observable systems.
- Improve performance and scalability by profiling, tuning, and refactoring critical paths.
- Mentor junior engineers, run design reviews, and help shape our engineering best practices and CI/CD.
- Participate in on-call rotation to troubleshoot production incidents and drive postmortems.

What we need (mandatory)
- Strong, practical experience building production systems in Go.
- Proven experience designing and operating Microservices architectures.
- Solid understanding of distributed systems principles, RPC/HTTP APIs, and data modeling for services.
- Experience writing automated tests, CI pipelines, and deploying services to cloud environments.
- Excellent communication skills and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced startup.

Bonus points (preferred / good-to-have)
- Prometheus
- Redis
- Kubernetes

Experience: 6+ years
Location & work mode: Fully remote within India.
